verdict.rationale: Retell publishes an API reference section (e.g. the clone-voice endpoint page documenting parameters such as up to 25 audio files), so a browsable reference exists. Nothing shows it is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and the OpenAPI probes at standard paths all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console or playground, runnable code examples within the reference, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
